rules.statement: A broker who constitutes himself the other contracting party to a transaction is not entitled to sue on the footing of a brokering contract.
rules.supporting_quote: 'It is obvious that the defendant gravely failed in his duty to the plaintiff. He was instructed to buy shares but he never carried out his mandate. A broker who is employed to buy shares cannot sell his own shares unless he makes a full and accurate disclosure of the fact to his principal and the principal with a full knowledge gives his assent to the changed position of the broker.'
